name: Icon Gallery
description: Download and use community-made icons in GD!

vanilla-more-icons.name: Vanilla as More Icons
vanilla-more-icons.description:
<cy>**ENGLISH**</c>: Icons with the <cf>Vanilla</c> format will be treated the same as Icons with the <cp>More Icons</c> format.

That means, they'll end inside the <cc>Texture Pack</c>'s <cp>More Icons</c> folder.
***
<cy>**SPANISH**</c>: Iconos con el formato <cf>Vanilla</c> se trataran igual que iconos con formato <cp>More Icons</c>.

Es decir, terminarian dentro de las carpetas <cp>More Icons</c> del <cc>Texture Pack</c>.

auto-unpack.name: Automatic unpacking
auto-unpack.description:
<cy>**ENGLISH**</c>: Icons you downloaded from the gallery will be extracted and added right away on the designated Pack folder.
***
<cy>***SPANISH**</c>: Iconos descargados seran extraidos y agregados de una vez en la carpeta del Pack designado.

delete-zips.name: Delete ZIP Packs
delete-zips.description:
<cy>**ENGLISH**</c>: If you want to delete the ZIP package after an icon is unpacked.
***
<cy>**SPANISH**</c>: Si deseas borrar el paquete ZIP despues que un icono sea extraido.

resources-folder.name: Use Resources Folder
resources-folder.description:
<cy>**ENGLISH**</c>: Icons with the <cf>Vanilla</c> format would end up in the main game resources folder.

<cr>Do not enable it if you don't want to replace vanilla Icons.</c>
***
<cy>**SPANISH**</c>: Iconos con el formato <cf>Vanilla</c> terminarian en la carpeta de recursos principales del juego.

<cr>No lo actives si no quieres reemplazar los Iconos originales.</c>
resources-folder.enable-if-description: Disable the "Vanilla as More Icons" setting

more-icons-folder.name: Use More Icons folder
more-icons-folder.description:
<cy>**ENGLISH**</c>: If you want **ALL** downloaded icons end up inside the folders of the <cp>**More Icons Mod**</c>.

<cr>Keep in mind you could override some of your own icons.</c>
***
<cy>**SPANISH**</c>: Si quieres que **TODOS** los iconos descargados terminen dentro de las carpetas del <cp>**Mod de More Icons**</c>.

<cr>Toma encuenta que pdorias reemplazar algunos que tengas.</c>
more-icons-folder.enable-if-description: This option requires More Icons to be installed

icon-pack-folder.name: Icons Pack Folder
icon-pack-folder.description:
<cy>***ENGLISH**</c>: Where all the downloaded icons will end up.
The mod will set-up a <cc>texture pack</c> at the start and assigns this the location.

Make sure to apply it on the <cg>Texture Loader</c> manager.
***
<cy>***SPANISH**</c>: El destino de los iconos que descargues de la Galeria.
El mod crea automaticamente un <cc>Texture Pack</c> al inicio y le asigna este destino.

Asegurate de que tengas el Texture Pack aplicado con el <cg>Texture Loader</c>

experimental-export.name: New Unpacking Code
experimental-export.description:
<cy>**ENGLISH**</c>: If you want to test the new icon unpacking function, allows you to rename the icon filename if a name conflict is found.

This is an experimental feature, to test it out before replacing the main code.
***
<cy>**SPANISH**</c>: Si quieres probar la nueva funcion de extraer iconos, que te pide que cambies el nombre de archivo de un icono si se detecta un conflicto.

Esta es una funcion experimental, para ponerla a prueba antes de reemplazar el codigo principal.
